# Lightspeed Retail X-Series

Read retailer configuration, products, customers, and sales from Lightspeed Retail X-Series across independently connected retailer accounts.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/lightspeed/.

## Actions

- **Get Customer** (read-only): Retrieve one Lightspeed customer by their exact customer ID.
- **Get Product** (read-only): Retrieve one Lightspeed product by its exact product ID.
- **Get Retailer** (read-only): Return the connected Lightspeed Retail X-Series retailer's identity, account status, configuration, and subscription state.
- **List Customers** (read-only): Return one cursor-controlled page of customers from the connected Lightspeed retailer.
- **List Payment Types** (read-only): Return one cursor-controlled page of payment types configured for the connected Lightspeed retailer.
- **List Products** (read-only): Return one cursor-controlled page of products from the connected Lightspeed retailer for catalog discovery.
- **List Sales** (read-only): Return one cursor-controlled page of sales from the connected Lightspeed retailer.
